All computations rerun against the exact embedded standalone checker, with no extrapolated quantifiers.

Queries for the exact 21-sphere closed case found no equivalence, but this is not proof of absolute novelty. Residual unindexed priority risk remains.

value.rationale: This is the first natural four-cycle boundary of the established higher-girth clique-fiber Čech classification, not an arbitrary induced subgraph slice. At n>=5 the same closed-neighborhood construction has a surviving fundamental circle and 4n second-homology generators; the excluded n=4 case instead becomes simply connected and has 21 generators, obstructing naive extension of the known theorem. The missing exact integral homotopy type is the precise invariant needed to understand the sharp scope of the uniqueness-of-neighborhood argument. The finite classification is complete and reproducible, without inflated generality.
